newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close mixed on thin market.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close mixed on thin market.

text.p: UK grain futures closed mixed on Monday after a thinly traded session.
"There have been very few sellers about, but even if there had been more, buyers were not showing much interest," said a trader.
Wheat closed around 0.25 to 0.40 stg down after trading 214 lots.
News that Saudi Arabia is in the market to import 500,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley had little impact on barley futures which closed 0.25 stg up after trading 22 lots.
UK physical grain traded was very quiet.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contract was neglected. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
